Sandbox_ConditionalSpeechDisablePhrases_: Disable phrases by writing out their IDs, separated by commas.\nExample: Bleeding,Sick,Hungry
Sandbox_ConditionalSpeechAllowClientModO: Allow Clients To Edit Mod Options
If disabled, players (including the host) can't change Conditional Speech's Mod Options - they'll see the current settings greyed out.
Sandbox_ConditionalSpeechSpeechCooldown_: Minimum time between lines of speech. Repeating the same category of line takes 3x this long.
